reason: I have a big lump sum sitting in SBI NRO and I do not want to fly to India or chase a CA across time zones. Paying a few hundred dollars on a sum this size to have it handled, with a named person on Canadian hours, is easy to justify.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? Fee only on arrival and the redo/refund promise help, but my money is still sitting in limbo, and a refund of their fee does not fix that.
